description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart comparing the distribution of three response categories for two conditions labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner).” Each ring contains 3 slices: Deceived (red), Partially (yellow), and Not Deceived (green). In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the red Deceived slice is labeled 67.6%, the yellow Partially slice is 23.5%, and the green Not Deceived slice is 8.8%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the red Deceived slice is labeled 57.9%, the yellow Partially slice is 31.6%, and the green Not Deceived slice is 10.5%. Percentage labels are printed directly on the slices, and two legends on the right map colors to labels for the outer and inner rings; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments appear arranged consistently by category around both rings.
